cards.details: RAM is volatile memory — its contents are lost when the computer is powered off.
cards.hint: It is the short-term working memory of a computer.

cards.prompt: Which data structure operates on a Last-In First-Out (LIFO) principle?
cards.details: A stack pushes items on top and pops from the top. Think of a stack of plates.

cards.prompt: What is the time complexity of binary search?
cards.details: Binary search halves the search space on each step, requiring at most log₂(n) comparisons.
